assessment: This manuscript lays out the framework for addressing an important challenge in our understanding of cellular signal transduction: how complex extracellular inputs can be detected and processed using multiple receptors. This problem is addressed in the context of glycan receptors lectins, mediating very common but still not completely understood cell-cell interactions. Using information capacity analysis, the study addresses the importance of glycan input measurement by multiple receptors on the immune cells, showing how the signal detection can benefit from receptor crosstalk.
